Overview

Okayama is a city in Okayama with a population of 720,000. Known as the ‘Land of Sunshine’ with one of Japan’s best castle reconstructions and the beautiful Korakuen Garden. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
